QuestInfo.name: [Boss Battle] Lord Balrog
QuestInfo.0:
The hero Tristan sealed Lord Balrog in the bottom of the Cursed Temple, but the seal on his tomb was never completed. Defeat Lord Balrog and put a lid on his enormous power.



- #eParticipation Requirements#n

 1) Normal Mode: Lv. 65 - Lv. 200


- #Party Size#n: Party of one or more

- #eRoute#n: 

1) Normal Mode: Sleepywood, End of Cursed Temple


- #eFinal Reward#n: 

1) Normal Mode
                  #i1402062:# Baine Item
